scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --features nodejs --manifest-path ../../../../crates/bridgetime/bridge/Cargo.toml --js native.js --dts native.d.ts && tsc
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --features nodejs --manifest-path ../../../../crates/bridgetime/bridge/Cargo.toml --js native.js --dts native.d.ts && tsc
scripts.prepublishOnly: tsc && cp native.js dist/native.js && cp native.d.ts dist/native.d.ts || true
